sections.appearance: She has taken different forms throughout the main story after certain events, first as a seemingly inert keychain that contained her preserved backup data (named Kei.SAV). During operations against Decagrammaton, her data was uploaded into a custom-built AMAS drone provided by Rio, with a single boxy screen displaying her "face" atop a single tire and with a pair of three-fingered manipulator arms. Eventually, she was able to acquire a humanoid form after pilfering an unused body from a facility under the control of Netzach and uploading her consciousness to it. Through Alice's authority, she sheds the physical traits of the Decagrammaton and becomes her ideal self, gaining a more human appearance. Her skin is pale, and her hair is almost as long as Alice's. The principal differences are in its white coloration compared to Alice's black, and the center bang hanging in the opposite direction (rightward relative to her perspective). Her original pink eyes are preserved from back when she took control of Alice's body, but bear a much sharper, tsurime appearance. Halo ==== Kei's halo is a flipped version of Alice's halo with a shade of pink instead of blue. Uniform ==== In her current form, her clothing is very reminiscent to that of her clubmates in the Game Development Department, mainly Alice's, with some slight differences, such as the inner section of her jacket being colored in a strong, almost fluorescent shade of pink and the fact she's wearing a dark gray colored blazer

Uniform ==== In her current form, her clothing is very reminiscent to that of her clubmates in the Game Development Department, mainly Alice's, with some slight differences, such as the inner section of her jacket being colored in a strong, almost fluorescent shade of pink and the fact she's wearing a dark gray colored blazer underneath. In addition, her skirt is noticeably shorter than Alice's, and instead of socks, she wears thigh-highs stockings. Firearm ==== Much like Alice, she also makes use of a railgun. However, Kei's model was designed by Rio alongside Himari and is a modernized version of Sword of Light. The weapon is predominantly black and white in coloration with some pink highlights, and bears a longer, spear-like appearance. It's "core" is colored yellow.

sections.personality: Kei initially presented as an AI program concerned only with "guiding the Princess to her throne" and enacting the destruction of Kivotos and the genocide of its people through the construction of the Ark of Atra-Hasis. Ever since her Princess decided she wanted to be a hero instead, Kei prioritizes Alice's safety above all, sacrificing herself to keep her alive before being reborn through the assistance of Rio and Himari. Ever since, Kei has begun developing more emotions, displaying a somewhat caustic personality towards the rest of the Game Development Department and some tsundere tendencies. She has also become very hot-headed, to the point where members of the SPTF acknowledge her constant anger. However, beyond everything, her will to live on has grown stronger than ever. She considers the capabilities of Decagrammaton and its prophets to be barely a fraction of what her creators could do.
